mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 7.5% signals economic distress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors seek safe-haven assets.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 7.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and real GDP (GDPC1) signals a deepening recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates policy responses and earnings deterioration.
failure_condition: The joint decline in INDPRO and GDPC1 does not lead to negative 20d returns in at least 60% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 7.0%), a decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.1 percentage points signals an aggressive monetary easing response to economic distress, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE > 7.0% and FEDFUNDS declines by >0.1pp, the 20-day forward returns are positive in less than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 550,000 units signals weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates reduced economic activity.
failure_condition: HOUST < 550.0 does not lead to negative 20d returns in at least 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment (PAYEMS) and real sales (RSAFS) signals a broad-based economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: The joint decline in PAYEMS and RSAFS does not lead to negative 20d returns in at least 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in industrial production (INDPRO) signals strengthening economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market anticipates better corporate earnings.
failure_condition: INDPRO trend does not produce positive 60d returns in at least 60% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% does not lead to negative 20d returns in at least 60% of cases.
